# Moovicut

> Free, local-first storyboard and shot list. No account and no video rendering.

Prompts work with Grok Imagine, Google, or any other AI image or video model. Moovicut does not render video.

- [Product guide](product.md): local planning, storage, and output.
- [FAQ](faq.md): models, local work, export, and storage.
- [Full agent guide](llms-full.txt): document contract, browser automation, and CLI examples.
- [Site index](index.md): routes and local workflow. The studio is `/studio`.
- [Agents](agents.md): `/mcp`, `GET /openapi.json`, `POST /api/v1/storyboard`, and `/agents`.

The default board is 5 scenes × 3 seconds (15s). Pass `shots`, `duration`, or a `scenes` array for a custom scene-by-scene board. Humans can do the same with Step-by-step mode in `/studio`. Scenario mode accepts a `scenario` object or text, or `input: "prose"` for deterministic detection. Presets `anime`, `cinema`, and `documentary` lock style into every generated shot. A hand-edited prompt is kept unless `overwritePrompt` is true. `regenerateShot` plus `project` rebuilds one shot. `warnings` is included only when a shot looks risky, and it never blocks the board. Every mode shares one film sheet. `format: "agent"` returns `shotboard.compact.v1`. A personal library of characters, places, and styles stays in the browser and can be exported. `model` accepts grok, google, sora, kling, runway, luma, wan, or generic. Veo clips are 4, 6, or 8 seconds in 16:9 or 9:16. Unverified limits are marked in `app/utils/model-profiles.js`.

Canonical schema: `shotboard.v1`. Canonical browser API: `window.Shotboard` (`window.Moovicut` is the same object). CLI: `node cli/moovicut.mjs` (`shotboard` is the same command). Remote API: `POST /api/v1/storyboard`. MCP: `POST /mcp`. Discovery: `/.well-known/mcp.json`. No API key and no stored premises.
